Marissa / Karen —

Per Marissa's ask, below are the redline suggestions from Redwood Legal (summary form; I will produce machine-readable redline in the contract system if you want tracked changes):

1) Uptime measurement: we agree to measure uptime on a per-tenant, per-region basis using the standard availability metric in section X ("successful token-serving request rate" / minute granularity). We can include a sample Prometheus query as an appendix.

2) Service credit cap: we are willing to accept a cumulative credit cap but propose a structure to limit commercial exposure: cap = min(20% of monthly committed spend, $150k) per 12-month rolling period. Rationale: protects both sides for very large contracts and provides an absolute limit for operational risk. If Strata insists on pure % we can consider 20% without dollar cap for deals <= $200k/month.

3) Scheduled Maintenance definition: propose three buckets —
  - Planned Maintenance (window published 7 days in advance) — excluded from credit calculation if notified per section Y,
  - Rolling Infrastructure Patches (non-customer-impacting; standard OS/kernel patching) — excluded provided not more than X hours of observable service reduction across >5% of customer nodes,
  - Emergency Maintenance (security fixes) — may be excluded if notified within 24 hours of action and root cause is provided.

4) Response times / P1 handling: we accept 1-hour initial response for P1 incidents during Redwood business hours for Standard plans; for Dedicated (reserved capacity) we accept 30-minute initial response and a 4-hour remediation target to qualify for higher credit buckets.

5) Evidence & auditability: we will provide SOC2 report and 6 months of availability traces upon request under NDA.

Please see the attached "Legal_SLA_illustration.pdf" for suggested contract text. If acceptable, I'll convert into tracked changes in the MSA + Order Form and send back.

-Kimberly

- Maintenance blackout windows: Strata needs one 4-hour blacked-out window per month for critical background jobs.
